events.event_identity: One Aflac June 2025 cybersecurity incident; distinct from the separate Allianz Life incident.
events.cutoff_rule: Existing Arctic Shift title witness captured 2025-06-20T12:46:30Z plus 30 minutes; v4 cutoff unchanged.
events.input_text: Aflac reported that it detected unauthorized access to its U.S. network on June 12 and believed it contained the intrusion within hours. The business remained operational and the filing said systems were not affected by ransomware. A review of potentially affected files was in an early stage; the company could not yet determine the number of affected people or the full scope. Potentially affected files could contain claims, health, Social Security and other personal information. Aflac said it expected to notify regulators and affected individuals and offer credit monitoring and identity protection.
events.input_text_kind: Time-bounded human summary of the original SEC Form 8-K accession, accepted before cutoff; original archived public-post title also retained.
